name: microfreak-patch
description: Put a sound the user describes in words into a MicroFreak preset slot: oscillator type and knobs, filter, envelopes, LFO, glide, bend range, scale, unison, chord mode, preset volume and the modulation matrix, with an optional sequence. Use when asked to make, program, change or check a patch, preset, sound, lead, bass, pad or stab on the MicroFreak. Routes to the garden page Microfreak/Patch/Write a patch and the mise tasks microfreak:write-patch and microfreak:probe.
